sentences.text:
==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 4 22-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
The petitioner is in custody since 26.08.2022 in connection with Darbhanga Town P.S. Case No. 244 of 2020 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420/406/34/467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section and BPID Act, 2002.
Vide order dated 04.03.2023, a report was called for, Shri Jharkhandi Upadhyay, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State has produced the report of the Senior Superintendent of Police,
Darbhanga which shows that the accused No. 1 (Anil Kumar Chaudhary), 2 (Sonu Kumar Chaudhary) and 3 (Sumita Chaudhary) are absconding a process under Sections 82 and 83 of the Cr.P.C. are being taken.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.71875 of 2022(4) dt.22-03-2023
The role of the police is not only to get process issued but make sincere efforts to arrest the accused.

The accused who are absconding have floated the non-banking finance company and have cheated a large number of persons of that area and the amount cheated from the general public at large may run into crores.

The Senior Superintendent of Police, Darbhanga is directed to form a special task force for arresting Prabhash Kumar Thakur @ Prabhash Thakur vs The State Of Bihar on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55685468/
1 the absconding accused persons.

entities.text: Prabhash Kumar Thakur @ Prabhash Thakur vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: List this case after four weeks for further hearing.
On that day, the arrest status of the accused persons be sent to this Court by the Senior Superintendent of Police, Darbhanga again.
From the F.I.R., it is clear that the non-banking finance company had continued to function properly till 2017- 2018.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner was terminated on 07.04.2016 itself and, therefore, his prosecution in the present case cannot be sustained without expressing any opinion on the role of the petitioner, the petitioner is granted interim bail.

In view of the above, let the petitioner above named be released on provisional bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.71875 of 2022(4) dt.22-03-2023 Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M.,
Darbhanga in connection with Darbhanga Town 244 of 2020, with a condition that he will cooperate with the police in the investigation and also to secure the arrest of the absconding accused.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) sunnykr/-
